utility_title: Deterministic SHA-256 Inventory for Build Artifacts
utility_use_case: Before sharing a computational research run or a software release candidate, inventory the artifact directory and retain the JSON with the run or release record. Later, a team can compare inventories or recompute file hashes to detect content changes. This supports reproducibility and build-artifact review, but it does not establish provenance, verify signatures, or guarantee that a build process was safe.
